reviewScope.target: Publicly available temporal pickleball stroke footage with stroke labels, documented provenance, and rights suitable for commercial model training
requirements: Downloadable temporal media, not only code, model weights, still images, metadata, or tabular match events
Pickleball-specific stroke labels with temporal boundaries
Documented media provenance and participant or rights-holder authority
License or release that expressly permits the intended commercial model-training use
Enough athlete, technique, camera, and environment diversity for leakage-safe evaluation
reviewScope.conclusion: No reviewed source satisfies all requirements. No public media was downloaded. A consent-first first-party collection is required for the stroke recognizer, phase detector, contact detector, and technique scorer.

sources.name: PickleBall Detection

provenance.limitation: The official project page declares CC BY 4.0 but publishes no collection description or underlying image provenance, so uploader authority over every image cannot be verified from the source page.

limitations: No temporal phase or contact labels

Too small to establish athlete, environment, device, and technique coverage

sources.name: Pickleball Pen Ball Tracking

provenance.limitation: The official page declares MIT but does not identify the source media or establish the publisher's authority over it.

officialSearchChecks.result: All 20 matching sportsgirl/Pickleball01 through Pickleball20 repositories contained only .gitattributes and had no dataset card, media, labels, or license.

officialSearchChecks.service: NARA National Archives Catalog (catalog.archives.gov, records/search API via site proxy)
officialSearchChecks.result: All 15 catalog records matching 'pickleball' are Textual Records (Trademark Official Gazette issues, White House daily diaries/news summaries, a National Children's Study resource guide). The same query filtered to typeOfMaterials=Moving Images returns 0 records. The two-word variant '"pickle ball"' returns 6 records, all textual. NARA holds no pickleball moving images.

officialSearchChecks.service: NARA National Archives Catalog — adaptable racket-sport moving-image sweep
officialSearchChecks.result: Every inspected racket-sport-adjacent moving image carries useRestriction.status='Restricted - Possibly' (Copyright or Public Law 101-246 USIA restriction) and/or has no downloadable digital objects; most are 1940s-1970s military newsreel film with at most seconds of incidental play. The 47 'warrior games' items are 2010-era events that predate pickleball's inclusion in the Warrior Games; none mentions pickleball (the pickleball query above already covers all NARA mentions). No item is both clearly US-government public domain and pickleball-relevant. The 'tennis' moving-image query could not be retrieved (the catalog proxy returned the SPA HTML page instead of JSON on two attempts); it was not needed to establish the pickleball result. The three most relevant restricted items are registered in quarantinedUnknownRights (nara-543949313, nara-52717, nara-602178033).

officialSearchChecks.service: DVIDS public video search re-check (dedup gap-check against existing corpus)
officialSearchChecks.result: The public DVIDS video search for 'pickleball' returns 16 videos (IDs 906546, 943757, 944209, 944403, 944593, 956784, 957519, 967848, 986421, 1007845, 1008415, 1011384, 1011773, 1011822, 1019773, 1019785). Every one of the 16 IDs already appears in the existing corpus/bundles (dvids-* IDs under datasets/paddle-bench). DVIDS remains exhausted: 0 new items.

officialSearchChecks.service: NASA Image and Video Library API (images.nasa.gov)
officialSearchChecks.result: One video matches: NHQ20230209ARMD01 'NASA's The Quiet Crew | Sriram Rallabhandi' (2023-02-09, 141 s employee-profile piece). Frame inspection of the downloaded medium rendition shows ~5 seconds of extremely distant recreational play on a tennis court (subjects tens of meters from a static camera; ball and paddle contact not resolvable). The gameplay shots appear to be personal/home footage contributed by the interviewee, which NASA's media usage guidelines flag as potentially third-party material, and the footage has no perception value at that distance. Excluded; nothing downloaded into the corpus. Searches for 'badminton' (media_type=video) return 0.

officialSearchChecks.url: site-restricted web searches for 'pickleball video' on va.gov, nps.gov, defense.gov

No new downloadable US-government pickleball video found outside DVIDS.
